name: Gästehaus Lukasser
beschreibung: The Gästehaus Lukasser is located in Tirol, Österreich. The atmosphere of the house is quiet and relaxed. Guests can expect comfortable but simple accommodation. The surroundings consist of the typical mountain landscape of Tirol. Hiking trails and local recreation areas are in the immediate vicinity. The amenities include rooms with private bathroom and satellite television. A breakfast buffet is offered. The location is suitable for excursions in the region.
